Rock Springs, Wyoming / October 2025

Fabric-reinforced clinic roof

War Horse completed this fabric-reinforced roof for a clinic in Rock Springs in October 2025. The project called for two stages of reinforcement before the white finish went on.

Four inches at every seam

The clinic scope called for cleaning, pressure-washing, and priming the existing roof. At each seam, the crew specified a four-inch strip of polyester fabric embedded in the base coat.

Fabric across the whole roof

The next layer extended fabric across the full roof surface. Around the A/C units and other openings, the specification combined fabric, sealant, and coating to tie those edges into the surrounding roof.

A reflective finish

The project specified a reflective white topcoat over the reinforced surface.
